teaser: Three companies, no LinkedIn pages: the decisions, every drafted field with its count, thirty first posts already written, and a new profile, in the open.
core_idea: Setting up LinkedIn pages for sgit.ai, the SGit Newsroom and RiskMandate is done in the open as part of the story: the addresses are free, the newsroom gets a company page because a showcase page cannot be an employer, every field is drafted against LinkedIn's limits, the first posts are articles already published, and the founder's profile ties the companies together.

quotes.text: The newsroom is now a business of its own, with its own model, so it gets a company page.
Here it is before it is done.

figures.caption: Three LinkedIn pages and a profile. sgit.ai, Git for encrypted vaults; the SGit Newsroom, a publication written in the open by an editor and a desk of agents; and RiskMandate, Agent Behaviour Policies for AI agents; each with its tagline, its industry and ten first posts drawn from material already published; and the founder's profile tying them together. The Cyber Boardroom, the legal entity behind sgit.ai and RiskMandate, sits underneath.
